comment: Original Alesis Midiverb II Bloom-patch-inspired reverb approximation: diffuse long-tail stereo reverb with a controllable swelling wet attack. Not an exact algorithm or factory-preset dump.
fxid_comment: 0x01E7. Unused by current effect manifests and tools/effects_db.json at implementation time.

params.name: Bloom
params.comment: Wet attack swell, from a quick rise to a slow several-second bloom.

params.name: Decay
params.comment: Reverb tail length, from a short ambience to a long sustained wash.

params.name: Tone
params.comment: Damping of high frequencies in the reverb tail.
